development.use: method and tool development, variance studies, fixed-reference selection; never reported as test results
development.earlier_use: distribution v0 with the same master seed generated the error-study sites (0-7) and the predictor-data sites (100-139); those draws differ from v1 draws

pilot.use: Phase 4 pilot; its variance informs the power analysis; not part of the test set

test.n_sites: set by the frozen power analysis before any test campaign
test.indices: 0 to N-1 in order; no index is skipped except by the preregistered exclusion rules of the distribution

reveal: pilot and test master seeds are revealed (with salts) only after the formal matrix is locked; openings are kept in output/private (not in Git) and backed up by the user
log: every generated site, exclusion and version is recorded in the run records of the batch that uses it
